verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers cap table management, fundraising modeling, SAFEs, 409A valuations, and compliance, but contains no mention of an investor-facing portal or structured update/reporting feature that would let investors self-serve their holdings without contacting the founder. Stakeholder profile views (pulley-docs-4) appear to be an admin-side feature, not an investor portal. missing for 10: dedicated investor portal login, structured update/reporting tool for investors, evidence investors can self-serve holdings data.
